How do I get ChatGPT to recommend my apartment community?

Short answer

To get ChatGPT to recommend your apartment community, make it the easiest property for AI to describe with confidence. AI looks for clear, consistent, current facts on your website, Google Business Profile, listing sites and reviews. It skips properties whose information is thin or contradictory.

The SocialDM · Nov 11, 2026
The problem

Why most communities get skipped

01Your website talks about lifestyle but never plainly answers renter questions such as price range, pet policy, parking or what is nearby.
02Your rent, specials and floor plans say one thing on your site and another on listing sites.
03Your Google Business Profile is missing categories, amenities or recent photos.
04Reviews are old, few, or rarely answered.
05Nothing outside your own website mentions your community in a way AI trusts.
What it costs youRenters who ask ChatGPT for "pet friendly apartments near downtown Phoenix" get a short list. If you are not on it, you never get the tour.

FAQ

Questions we hear

Can an agency guarantee ChatGPT will recommend my property?

No. Anyone who guarantees placement is overpromising. What we can do is make your property the easiest one for AI to describe accurately, and measure the result.

How long does it take?

It depends on how much was missing. We measure where you stand first and report the change every week, so you see movement as it happens.

Is this different from SEO?

It builds on SEO, but AI answers are judged differently from keyword rankings.
